findings.title: i18next message converted to Java MessageFormat/choice syntax
findings.body: The account-ui (and admin-ui) message bundles are consumed by the React apps through i18next, which interpolates `{{0}}`-style placeholders and has no support for Java MessageFormat `{0}` or `{2,choice,...}`. Changing `error-invalid-multivalued-size` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.` means the end user will see the literal text `{0}`, `{1}` and `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` instead of substituted values. The same applies to js/apps/admin-ui/.../messages_en.properties:3138. Only the server-side themes/ bundles (Freemarker/MessageFormat) can use the choice syntax.

findings.title: Common-prefix/suffix trimming can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: The two loops computing `start` and `end` are independent, so `start + end` can exceed the string length when the differing part is a repetition of surrounding characters (e.g. value="aa", sanitized="aaa" yields start=2, end=2). The subsequent `value.substring(start, value.length() - end)` then gets end index < begin index and throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException, crashing the build with an opaque error instead of reporting the illegal HTML. Clamp `end` to `min(end, length - start)` for both strings.

findings.title: Missing English reference bundle aborts verification with RuntimeException
findings.body: `verifySafeHtml()` derives the English file path by string replacement and throws an unchecked RuntimeException if it cannot be opened. Any bundle whose English counterpart does not exist at the derived path (community-only message directories, bundles without a locale suffix, or paths where the `resources-community`→`resources` substitution does not yield a real file) will fail the build with a raw RuntimeException instead of a MojoExecutionException/skippable warning. Handle the missing-file case explicitly (skip or report a message).

findings.title: santizeAnchors removes the wrong anchor occurrence and reports without file context
findings.body: Inside the loop, `value.replaceFirst(...)` always strips the *first* occurrence of the English anchor tag in the (already modified) value, while `matcher` still iterates the original string. With more than one identical anchor tag per message the positions get out of sync, so a mismatched/injected anchor can be silently removed (false negative) or a valid one flagged. Also the message added at line 157 contains neither the key nor the file name, making the failure hard to locate; all other messages include them.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` was replaced with `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian sentence. The same wrong text was introduced in themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties (totpStep1).

findings.title: Simplified-Chinese bundle given Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: `totpStep1` was set to `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：`, which is Traditional Chinese (zh_TW) wording/characters, in the zh_CN (Simplified) bundle. Should use Simplified characters, e.g. `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.

findings.title: No positive test that a clean bundle yields no findings
findings.body: All new tests assert that a violation is reported; none asserts the opposite (e.g. verifying `noHtml_en.properties` or a file with allowed `<b>`/anchor identical to English returns an empty message list). Without such a test, a regression that makes the sanitizer report false positives for legitimate messages (a likely outcome given the unescaping/`<!-- -->` hacks) would go undetected.
